request.summary: Create an opt-in PDF document workspace that matches the proven legacy renderer feature set and adds interactive form, annotation, search, and external-control surfaces without adding PDF.js to unrelated apps.
request.audience: Near-view operators, visitors, and staff using document kiosks, policy stations, form terminals, and unattended signage readers.
request.primaryGoal: Reliably render one file or an ordered folder of PDFs with complete navigation, discovery, interaction, and automation controls on legacy Wallboard players.

assumptions: PDF files are selected through Wallboard File System settings and cached through the SDK before PDF.js loads them.
PDF.js 2.3.200 is pinned because it matches the proven legacy renderer generation and remains isolated inside the opt-in capability.
The two fictional Northline PDFs are preview fixtures only; a production placement requires a selected file or folder.
Sensor events expose page and interaction telemetry, but custom apps cannot register the legacy proof-of-display lifecycle through the current SDK.

surfaceStrategy.rationale: Document readers may be full-screen landscape, portrait kiosks, compact embedded tools, or square playlist zones.

surfaces.purpose: Full document workspace with sidebar, reader, and floating controls.
Compact reader with optional overlay sidebar and condensed controls.
Portrait kiosk preserving document scale and complete tools.
Square reader where the sidebar becomes an overlay and document space remains primary.

ownership.rationale: Operators select one protected file or an ordered File System folder without changing code.
The same renderer supports kiosk, unattended reader, form station, and controlled-document use cases.
Coordinated presets remain safe defaults while Custom exposes a complete semantic palette.
Reader and form state is placement-local and resets when the app is remounted.
Playlists and control contents can operate the reader without simulated pointer input.
Compatibility, bounded rendering, worker packaging, and cleanup are code-owned invariants.

views.purpose: Render the active PDF page or continuous document track.
Select among ordered folder documents and submit or reset form values.
Search extracted text across every loaded document and move through matches.

inputs.action: Navigate pages, documents, outlines, links, form fields, downloads, search, and zoom.
Use the same large reader and sidebar controls on kiosk displays.
Enter search queries and AcroForm values and activate focused controls.
Navigate, search, zoom, download, submit forms, or reset forms remotely.

session.expectation: Navigation, search, zoom, and form values remain instance-local until remount or explicit reset.

outputs.expectation: Emit one deduplicated event when the active document page changes.
outputs.failure: Document rendering remains authoritative if telemetry is unavailable.

outputs.expectation: Emit link, annotation, page click, and submitted form-value interactions.
outputs.failure: Keep the reader interactive and do not claim that telemetry was persisted.

rendering.rationale: Workspace chrome reflows while each PDF page preserves its native ratio through the selected fit mode.

motion.rationale: Reader movement is functional scrolling or direct navigation; decorative transitions would hinder documents and forms.

branding.provenance: The example uses a fictional Northline document identity and generated semantic palettes.
branding.fallback: Use the coordinated Dark preset when no customer reference is supplied.

states.expectation: Two PDFs load with a complete file list, full reader, bounded canvases, and usable controls.
The light preset and portrait reader preserve document scale and tool access.
The sidebar is omitted by configuration and the compact canvas retains complete navigation controls.
Single-page mode, outline-first sidebar, and every Custom palette token remain coherent.
The continuous reader advances automatically while controls and page rendering remain bounded.

behaviors.expectation: Folder mode loads two ordered PDFs and six pages while keeping active canvases bounded.
Document and outline controls navigate to the exact document page.
Search extracts text across documents, highlights the current page, and wraps result navigation.
AcroForm values remain editable and submit as a structured sensor interaction.
Parameterized commands select exact pages and documents without pointer input.
Configured continuous auto-scroll moves the viewport and remains hover-pausable and rewindable.
Zoom controls update scale, obey configured bounds, and reset to the fit baseline.

visualDirection.summary: A restrained records-room workspace that gives the document most of the canvas and keeps tools quiet, precise, and explicitly functional.
references: Proven legacy Wallboard PDF renderer feature set
signatureChoices: A numbered document ledger and outline rail make multi-file sets immediately understandable.
Floating bottom controls preserve a large uninterrupted document field while remaining reachable on touch displays.

visualReview.intent: A production document station where source, current location, and next action are clear without competing with PDF content.
focus: Verify A4 pages remain sharp, centered, and correctly fitted in landscape, portrait, compact, and square surfaces.
Verify arbitrary filenames, outline labels, and search previews never resize or overlap the reader controls.
Verify PDF text, annotations, links, and form fields align with the canvas at every zoom and fit mode.
Verify Dark, Light, and Custom palettes affect all surrounding controls while leaving PDF page colors unchanged.
